metadataRaw.title: How to Instantly Fix an UPPER BACKACHE
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to instantly fix an upper backache — even in as little as 30 seconds!

Upper back pain is usually caused by a buildup of muscle weakness and tightness, especially in the trapezius muscle group.

To fix this, the exercises focus on stretching and strengthening the main upper back muscles for both quick and long-lasting relief.

Each exercise works differently. They’re shown in different positions and target different muscles. For the best results, go through all of them and use the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now and fix an upper backache in seconds!
